```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           pv.product_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
sums AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS quantity,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS revenue_cents
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id
),
oc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
),
vc AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       oc.order_count          AS order_count,
       s.quantity              AS quantity,
       s.revenue_cents         AS revenue_cents,
       vc.variant_count        AS variant_count
  FROM sums s
  JOIN oc          ON oc.product_id = s.product_id
  JOIN vc          ON vc.product_id = s.product_id
  JOIN products p  ON p.id = s.product_id
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De originele query sorteert ~81k samengevoegde rijen op (product, order) voor `count(DISTINCT o.id)`, en dat loopt over naar schijf (external merge). In de herschrijving wordt eerst per product geaggregeerd, en de distinct-tellingen gebeuren via hash-aggregatie van (product, order) en (product, variant) op de gefilterde basisset. Daardoor verdwijnt de grote sort met temp-I/O, en `products` wordt pas aan het eind aan de al geaggregeerde rijen gejoind.
